tools.description: Pay for the next step of an Upgrade with the Materials and Relics it costs. Ask td_get_actions for the Upgrades on offer. Refused with UPGRADE_MAXED when there is no step left and UPGRADE_UNAFFORDABLE when the Vault cannot pay.

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.

expected_seq.description: Refuse with STALE_SEQ if the Campaign's state_seq is not this.

request_id.description: Your own id for this call. Repeating it returns the first answer and acts once.

upgrade_id.description: The id of an Upgrade, as td_get_actions lists it.

tools.name: td_buy_upgrade

tools.description: Pay for Villagers from the Vault's Credits, at a price that rises with the number the Village already has. Takes in up to count, and fewer when the Vault runs out; that is reported as partial.

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.

count.description: How many to pay for. Default 1.

tools.description: End the Expedition now: the Party comes back to the Village with what it carries. Loot is banked, Supplies go back to the Pantry and the answer holds the Expedition Summary. It is never confirmed: it is the way out.

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.

request_id.description: Your own id for this call. Repeating it returns the first answer and acts once.

tools.name: td_extract

tools.description: List what the Campaign would accept now: which Unit Types can be recruited and how many, Villager and sale options, affordable Upgrades, and whether an Expedition can set out, a Reinforcement Wave can follow or the Party can Extract. Each refusal carries a reason code. Reads only.

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.

tools.name: td_get_actions

tools.description: Read the event feed of the Campaign after an event id: recruits, sales, Floors reached, Enemies slain, Expeditions ended. Oldest first. Use last_id as the next 'since'.

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.

limit.description: The most events in one answer. Default 100.

since.description: Only events after this id. Default 0.

tools.name: td_get_events

tools.description: Read the Village's Ledger: its latest plain lines, and the latest Expedition Summaries with the fallen named. Losses are written as plainly as gains.

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.

lines.description: How many Ledger lines, newest last. Default 20.

tools.name: td_get_ledger

tools.description: Read the fixed rules in sections: units, upgrades, shortcuts, milestones, tick. Call with no section for the list of sections. A Sandbox caller may also ask for 'enemies'. These are the values the player sees; nothing in them is Campaign state.

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.

section.description: The section to read. Omit for the list.

tools.name: td_get_rules

tools.description: Read the Campaign's current state: Vault, Pantry, Villagers, Reserves, and the Party, Supplies, Loot and Garrison while an Expedition is out. 'brief' is a few hundred tokens; 'full' adds the Roster, Upgrades, Milestones, Shortcuts and Trades. Units are counted by type, never listed one by one. Pass since_seq to skip an unchanged state.

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.

since_seq.description: Skip the state if it has not moved past this sequence number.

tools.name: td_get_state

tools.description: Read the Tower as far as the Party has climbed: highest Floor, Guardian and Surge Floors met, Guardians slain, Shortcuts, Milestones, and the Garrison of the current Floor during an Expedition. Floors not yet reached are not shown.

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.

tools.name: td_get_tower

tools.description: Recruit Units into the Reserves, paid from the Vault and from Loot the Party carries (carried Credits go first). The Credits must exceed the cost of each one, so fewer may be recruited than asked; that is reported as partial. The answer names each new Unit with its rolled health and damage factors and its knack.

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.

expected_seq.description: Refuse with STALE_SEQ if the Campaign's state_seq is not this.

request_id.description: Your own id for this call. Repeating it returns the first answer and acts once.

unit_type.description: The Unit Type to recruit; it must be unlocked.

tools.name: td_recruit

tools.description: Close a Sandbox Campaign you opened and discard it. This cannot be undone.

campaign.description: The Sandbox handle returned by td_sandbox_new.

tools.name: td_sandbox_close

tools.description: Open a Sandbox Campaign: a headless Campaign on a manual clock that advances only through td_wait, with its own copy of the rules. Pass a seed to repeat an earlier one; the seed in use is returned. The number open per grant and in all is capped, and so is its simulated time. Returns its handle for the 'campaign' argument.

max_simulated_seconds.description: A lower ceiling on its simulated time. Default the server's.

seed.description: The Sandbox's seed. Omit for a fresh one.

tools.name: td_sandbox_new

tools.description: Sell Food, Materials or Relics from the Village for Credits. Food is sold in whole units above the keep-back and is refused with WOULD_STARVE when the Pantry would no longer feed the Reserves, unless force is true. Materials and Relics take a number or 'all'. Selling cannot be undone.

amount.description: How much to sell: a positive number, or 'all' for Materials and Relics only. Food takes a whole number.

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.

expected_seq.description: Refuse with STALE_SEQ if the Campaign's state_seq is not this.

force.description: Food only: sell even if the Pantry would fall short.

request_id.description: Your own id for this call. Repeating it returns the first answer and acts once.

tools.name: td_sell

When fewer wait in the Reserves than asked, the Reinforcement Wave goes with those and the answer is partial. It climbs Floor by Floor and eats on the way.

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.

party.description: Who goes in the Reinforcement Wave. A count for each Unit Type, or 'all_reserves'.

request_id.description: Your own id for this call. Repeating it returns the first answer and acts once.

tools.name: td_send_reinforcement_wave

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.

expected_seq.description: Refuse with STALE_SEQ if the Campaign's state_seq is not this.

party.description: Who goes. A count for each Unit Type, or 'all_reserves'.

request_id.description: Your own id for this call. Repeating it returns the first answer and acts once.

start_floor.description: 0 starts at the foot of the Tower. Otherwise the Floor of an open Shortcut.

tools.name: td_start_expedition

tools.description: Wait for something to change. In a Sandbox this advances time, one simulated second per tick, until a condition holds or max_ticks pass. On a live Campaign it only watches, up to timeout_ms. Conditions: floor_changed, unit_lost, expedition_ended, supplies_below, party_health_fraction_below, ticks. One wait at a time.

campaign.description: A Sandbox handle. Omit to use your only open Sandbox.
